'''Hyperpaint''' was a product that could be applied to [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] and [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]]. [[Kuda's Compound]] on [[Stend VI]] offered hyperpaint services to its customers.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
